name: KIET Design Club
description:
KIET Design Club is the official creative design community of KIET Group of Institutions. We bring together passionate designers, visual storytellers, and creative thinkers under one roof.

Our club is dedicated to nurturing design talent across multiple disciplines — from UI/UX and graphic design to branding, typography, motion graphics, and digital illustration.

We organize workshops, design sprints, critique sessions, and inter-college competitions to give our members real-world exposure and hands-on experience with industry-standard tools like Figma, Adobe XD, Photoshop, and Illustrator.

Whether you are a beginner picking up your first design tool or an experienced designer looking to level up, KIET Design Club is your creative home.
